label: Freeform net
tooltip: Lay a clean quad net over the scan, snap it to the scan and drag points; the deviation shows live as a heatmap on the surface.
help: For organic shapes. Create net lays an even quad net over the whole scan or the selected triangles and snaps it to them. The surface is a smooth B-spline surface; its colour shows the distance to the scan: green within the tolerance, yellow to red outside the material, blue inside. Click and drag points; with snapping they slide over the scan. Snap to scan fits the surface again, Smooth calms it. OK creates the CAD faces: a body when the net is closed.
selectionMissing: Select triangles with the brush or smart select (at least {{min}}).
editHint: Points appear near the pointer. Click a point and drag it. Shift chooses more points, Ctrl removes, a rectangle chooses several. With Alt the point moves along the surface normal.
snap: Snap to the scan while dragging
legend: Green: within ±{{tolerance}}. Yellow to red: the surface lies outside the scan, blue: inside, grey: far away.

result.unmeasured: {{share}} of the surface lies far from the scan and is not counted.
result.openHint: The net has open borders. It becomes a surface, not a body.
